steps.do: For each remaining savings + card pair, compute the net yearly return: deposit × (sum of APY parts) minus fees. APY parts: the base or tier APY at that balance (Silver 4.0% at $10,000 or more, otherwise 2.5%; Silver Plus 4.5% at $15,000 or more, otherwise 3.0%); the highest card APY bonus on that account, from the account's own bonus table, among the candidate card and any card in cards_get; the linked-checking boost if the pair is listed; the Silver Plus 0.25% direct-deposit bonus only if the customer will set up direct deposit; and the 0.025% relationship bonus only where a document ties it to the pair (a Silver Account with a Platinum Rewards Card). Fees: 12 × the monthly maintenance fee if the balance is below the minimum, 12 × the paper-statement fee if paper is needed, and the card's annual fee. Silver Plus account: Bronze Rewards +0.15%, Silver Rewards +0.15%, Crypto-Cash Back +0%, Gold +0.2%, EcoCard +0.45%. The 0.025% relationship bonus appears for both Silver and Silver Plus. Treat it the same for both and do not let it decide between them. Add the Silver Plus direct-deposit +0.25% only if the customer says direct deposit will be active.
